title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description:
S01 E08 — Wait, That's Factory?
As people spend more time in cars, drivers crave the comforts of home; factory options like glove-box cocktail bars promise just that, though not all are created equal; join Jeff Dunham for a ride through the wacky world of factory options!

description:

Customs and Border Protection forms one of the world's largest law enforcement agencies, drawing officers from many backgrounds.

description:

The Stage Three Championship Round of Major League Fishing's Bass Pro Tour from Waco, TX, where the final 10 anglers compete for the trophy and a top prize of $125,000.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E03 — Clayton County, Georgia
Behind the walls of Clayton County Jail, deteriorating infrastructure creates dangerous conditions for both inmates and staff.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:

Virginia Beach is a party town with a vibrant nightlife, making its Correctional Center one of the busiest city jails in the state; here, some inmates arrive to go on vacation, then leave on probation, and return on a violation.

description:
S02 E02 — Tangipahoa Parish Jail
In Bloody Tangipahoa, a new sheriff takes on a parish defined by violence, fighting to pull a crumbling, neglected jail back from the brink while inmates work to rebuild the family bonds that could keep them from coming back.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E07 — Anderson County Jail
Anderson County, Tennessee, is federally recognized as an area affected by drug trafficking and gangs. With only one county jail, Sheriff Barker and his team combat crime while offering unique inmate reentry programs that reduce recidivism.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E03 — The Tip Jar Bandit
Tizzy investigates complaints of a serial tip jar thief; a woman goes on a tirade in a parking lot; the police sort out a cyclist's accusations against a motorist.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:

Tizzy tries to identify a man filmed pulling a gun on skateboarders; a road rager who reportedly used his coffee cup as a weapon is identified by his tattoos; a confrontation over a car charger leaves a woman seeking Tizzy's help.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E02 — The Kilted Keisterer?
Tizzy identifies a brazen shopper who places merchandise under his kilt; an angry golfer tees off on bystanders; a man has an ice cream truck meltdown; a woman claims a public beach as her own private yard.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:

Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

description:

Josh dives into a mysterious Greek sea passage known as the ancient world's shipwreck capital; chasing truth and treasure, Josh separates fact from myth and learns what makes these waters as deadly as the Bermuda Triangle.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:

Josh helps discover and explore a labyrinth of lost tunnels; he dodges traffic to assist in a first-ever radar scan below the busy streets of Cuzco, Peru; he joins them as they push into the tunnels and find priceless ancient treasures.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:

Josh joins archeologists as they bushwhack through thick jungles and rappel into vast caves in search of the lost Zoque culture.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:

Josh braves the African savanna to investigate the rampage of two lions who killed as many as 135 railroad workers in 1898; to prevent more bloodshed, Josh joins wildlife rangers tracking a pair of rogue lions who are on a modern-day killing spree.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E05 — Treasure of the Pirate Queen

description:

Matt hunts for rare liquor, hand-rolled cigars and vintage drums in two California hoards; when the owners refuse to part with key items, Matt's bottom line is threatened.

Matt takes on a rock star mess to find classic guitars and amps, vintage trucks and rare Harleys; the hoard's heavy metal puts the team at risk.

Matt tackles a hoard packed with high-value vintage toys and hidden loaded guns; Matt test-drives a 1960s British sports car and test-fires the weapons at a local gun range; lowball bids force the team to find new buyers; total sales top $100,000.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E06 — Santa's Fury Road to Riches
Matt scrambles to clear a bat-infested barn and turn a sea of Santa Clauses into big money; while tackling jobs in Michigan and Massachusetts, Matt finds a lost cache of rare coins; a '64 Plymouth Fury could be a score if the owner decides to sell.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:

A police officer's house in North Carolina is packed with fishing gear, rare Beatles records, guns and knives; in Tennessee, sports memorabilia has taken over a family's home; total sales top $100,000; a client is moved to give Matt a tribute.

description:

Officers are caught off guard when a high-end sports car arrives at the border packing heat. At the bus terminal, a K9 alerts to a traveler's luggage. Upon investigation, officers find photographs showing large amounts of cash on her phone.

description:

At the crossroads of one of the West Coast's busiest narcotics corridors, Sheriff Patrick Withrow and his deputies confront violent offenders, rival gangs and the ongoing battle to stop contraband from entering California's San Joaquin County Jail.
